title: Scopegrain capture ownership

sourceRel.description: Exact configured memory/captures/UUID.json path, checked at runtime; no caller path.

createdAt.description: Canonical Date.toISOString, equal to owning intent/event createdAt and note capturedAt.

description: Ownership requires a committed exact two-event operation, matching immutable snapshots, scopes, current sidecar bytes and current source bytes. A sidecar alone is not proof.
